problem.headline: Find owners in financial trouble before the broker network does.
problem.body: Bloomfield lends on and buys commercial property anywhere in the U.S. (not office). A bank has strict limits on how it can help a struggling borrower; Bloomfield has few. Reaching the borrower first means offering a loan that actually fixes the problem.
problem.story: A developer builds student housing in Ann Arbor. The opening slips from August to November, students sign leases elsewhere, the building sits empty for a year and the developer defaults. Bloomfield noticed because the project website still said "coming Winter 2026" after that date had passed.

worked: The Ann Arbor example is found automatically: stuck construction loan, stale opening date, contractor lien and a struggling lender, all on one property.
Every extracted value comes with the exact sentence it was read from, and made-up quotes are caught.
Records about the same property, loan, lender and company are linked; unsure matches go to a person.
Works with Claude, Gemini or an OpenAI-style service, with a spending cap and no private data sent.
